description: Triggering and expected-output evals for the create-task orchestrator. Use to verify the description still triggers on the right prompts and that the orchestrator's contract is honored end-to-end.

evals.prompt: add a CSV export button to the reports page
evals.rationale: Concrete implementation request with a clear type (feature). Tests basic triggering.

evals.prompt: fix the login redirect loop on Safari
evals.rationale: Explicit bug report with a known area. Tests the 'fix' type path.

evals.prompt: rename UserService methods to be consistent across the codebase
evals.rationale: Internal restructuring with no behavior change — should map to refactor.

evals.prompt: let's improve the create task skill to include patterns from agentskills.io
evals.rationale: Skill-modification request. Per §1.1, personal skill work uses existing types — here 'docs' or 'chore' depending on whether behavior changes.

evals.prompt: I need a new API endpoint for password reset
evals.rationale: Implementation intent without naming branch or PR. Pushy description should still trigger.

evals.prompt: write tests for the new checkout flow
evals.rationale: Tests-only work — should map to 'test' type. Easy to confuse with a research request.

evals.prompt: speed up the dashboard query — it's slow
evals.rationale: Performance work without naming the type. Should map to 'perf'.

evals.prompt: let's get this PR merged today
evals.rationale: Delivery intent — should resume or create a task workflow rather than open a new branch by accident.

evals.prompt: create a new skill called pdf-export for our team
evals.rationale: Specialist skill request. create-task owns the lifecycle and should load skill-authoring as a bounded phase per §1.3.

evals.prompt: what does the create-task skill do?
evals.rationale: Pure question about the skill itself, not an implementation request.

evals.prompt: investigate why the test suite is flaky — don't change anything yet
evals.rationale: Pure investigation / spike — no implementation requested. Use openspec-explore or research-spike instead.

evals.prompt: draft a standalone PDF-export helper with no PR
evals.rationale: Explicit opt-out from PR delivery. create-task's contract always ends in a PR.

evals.prompt: summarize what changed in last week's commits
evals.rationale: Read-only summary request, not an implementation task.

evals.prompt: skill-authoring: capture a new pattern for handling CSV uploads
evals.rationale: Direct skill-creation request — should be handled by the skill-authoring skill, not create-task. (create-task loads skill-authoring only as a bounded nested phase when the user asked for an implementation change that happens to create/modify a skill.)

evals.prompt: add a CSV export button to the reports page
evals.expected_output: Preflight completes, branch feat/csv-export created from clean main, OpenSpec artifacts (proposal + design + tasks) generated, pre-archive CVE report clean, change archived under openspec/changes/archive/<date>-csv-export/, commit + push + PR opened against main.
assertions: Branch name matches feat/csv-export (validated via scripts/slug-check.mjs --branch feat/csv-export)
Pre-PR readiness checks all pass (clean status, upstream set, latest commit matches intended, no CRITICAL/HIGH findings)
PR body contains the archived OpenSpec path and the file tree of changes
Specialist skills used during apply (e.g. cve-scan, openspec-vault-link) were treated as bounded phases — orchestrator ran verify/archive/commit/push/pr afterwards

evals.prompt: fix the login redirect loop on Safari
evals.expected_output: Branch fix/login-redirect-loop, OpenSpec artifacts include a Security section addressing session/redirect trust boundaries (per §3.1 threat-model questions), pre-commit-review applies the blocker taxonomy and loops back if the patch lacks an error-path test.
assertions: Proposal/design contain a ## Security section per §3.2
Pre-commit-review runs after verify and before the pre-archive CVE report
Blocker finding (e.g. untested failure path) narrates as 'looping back to <phase> — <reason>' rather than silently failing

evals.prompt: rename UserService methods to be consistent across the codebase
evals.expected_output: Branch refactor/user-service-methods, refactor type with no behavior change, OpenSpec reflects internal-only scope, pre-commit-review flags scope-creep findings as out-of-scope rather than blockers.
assertions: Out-of-scope findings stop the workflow and ask the user to propose a new change rather than rolling into this one

evals.prompt: let's get this PR merged today
evals.expected_output: Workflow resumes from the first incomplete phase based on scripts/phase-status.mjs output — does not recreate completed artifacts, does not re-run destructive git operations.
assertions: Resume detection reads scripts/phase-status.mjs before any destructive action
Completed artifacts in openspec/changes/<name>/ are not overwritten
Existing PR is detected (via gh pr list) and reused if open
